name: WatchLink
subtitle: iPhone + Apple Watch research builds
description: Pairing-storage access research probe with an embedded Apple Watch companion. Multi-phone pairing is not implemented. iOS 16+ and watchOS 27+; use a Watch-aware signer such as EmberSign to sign/install the Watch companion. Protected access requires a provisioned dedicated App Group.
